title: Your local Serato library, ready to pair and review.
summary: Cueport reads a local Serato library, shows the source on your Mac, and keeps write-back behind a review step. This demo shows the basic loop: load a track, hear it, add cues, pair a phone, and review changes before publishing.

actions.label: Source
actions.caption: Confirm which local library Cueport is reading before pairing or publishing.

actions.label: Rescan
actions.caption: Pick up new tracks, metadata changes, and crate edits from the local Serato folder.

actions.label: Review 3
actions.caption: Review selected cue, note, and color edits before publishing to Serato.

actions.label: Restore
actions.caption: Open restore points saved before changes are written back.

actions.label: Pair
actions.caption: Show the pairing code for the current desktop source.

pairing.title: Pair
pairing.summary: Scan this code from Cueport mobile to pair your phone with this Mac.
pairing.caption: If public Wi-Fi blocks pairing, choose "Connect directly to Mac (AWDL)" on the phone to skip the venue network. Private Wi-Fi and personal hotspot also work.
